description: Microsoft AutoGen is an open-source framework for building multi-agent AI systems where autonomous agents can converse with each other and with humans to solve tasks collaboratively. It simplifies the creation of complex LLM workflows with customizable agent behaviors and conversation patterns.

name: Semantic Kernel
description: Semantic Kernel is an open-source AI orchestration SDK by Microsoft that integrates LLMs with programming languages like C#, Python, and Java. It enables developers to build intelligent applications with AI agents, plugins, and planning capabilities for enterprise production use.

name: SuperAGI
description: SuperAGI is an open-source infrastructure platform for building and deploying autonomous AI agents, providing a visual GUI, agent marketplace, and tools for memory management. It allows teams to run multiple agents concurrently and monitor their performance in real time.

name: BabyAGI
description: BabyAGI is an open-source task-driven autonomous AI agent that uses LLMs and vector databases to create, prioritize, and execute tasks in pursuit of an overall goal. It was one of the first demonstrations of task-driven autonomous AI and inspired many subsequent autonomous agent frameworks.

name: MetaGPT
description: MetaGPT is an open-source multi-agent meta programming framework that assigns different roles to GPT agents to collaboratively develop software. It simulates a software company with agents acting as product manager, architect, engineer, and QA to produce entire codebases from a single requirement description.

name: ChatDev
description: ChatDev is an open-source virtual software company driven by LLM-powered agents that simulate different roles such as CEO, CTO, programmer, and tester to collaboratively create software. It uses structured chat workflows where agents communicate to design, code, test, and document complete applications.

name: Ultravox
description: Fixie AI is an AI agent platform that enables developers to build, deploy, and manage intelligent agents that can use tools, access data, and interact with external APIs. It provides a cloud infrastructure for hosting conversational AI agents with persistent memory and tool-use capabilities.

name: Lindy AI
description: Lindy AI is a no-code AI employee platform that lets users create autonomous AI agents called Lindies to automate repetitive business tasks like email management, scheduling, and CRM updates. Lindies can connect to 3,000+ apps and make decisions based on contextual understanding.

name: Relevance AI
description: Relevance AI is a no-code AI agent builder platform that enables businesses to create custom AI agents and multi-agent teams to automate sales, support, research, and operations workflows. Its visual builder allows non-technical users to chain AI tools and integrations without writing code.

name: Stack AI
description: Stack AI is a no-code AI workflow builder that enables enterprises to build and deploy AI applications and automations by connecting LLMs with data sources and APIs visually. It supports complex multi-step AI pipelines with integrations for databases, documents, and third-party services.

name: Flowise
description: Flowise is an open-source drag-and-drop UI tool for building LLM-powered applications and AI agent workflows using LangChain and LlamaIndex components. It enables developers to visually design chatbots, document QA systems, and agentic pipelines and deploy them as APIs.

name: Dify
description: Dify is an open-source LLM application development platform that combines visual workflow orchestration, RAG pipeline building, and AI agent creation in a unified interface. It supports deployment of production-ready AI applications with monitoring, version control, and team collaboration features.

name: Langflow
description: Langflow is an open-source visual workflow builder for creating AI pipelines and agents using LangChain components through a drag-and-drop interface. It enables rapid prototyping of RAG applications, multi-agent systems, and LLM workflows without extensive coding.

name: Pipedream
description: Pipedream is a serverless integration and automation platform that lets developers build workflows connecting APIs, databases, and AI models with code or a visual builder. It provides pre-built components for 1,000+ apps and supports real-time event-driven automation triggered by webhooks, schedules, or API events.

name: Activepieces
description: Activepieces is an open-source automation platform that provides a no-code interface for building workflows that connect popular apps and services. It is designed as a self-hostable alternative to Zapier and Make, with an extensible pieces framework for custom integrations.

name: Huginn
description: Huginn is an open-source system for building agents that monitor the web and automate tasks on your behalf, similar to a self-hosted IFTTT or Zapier. It can track websites, fetch data from APIs, send notifications, and chain complex automated workflows through a visual interface.

name: Temporal
description: Temporal is an open-source workflow orchestration platform that makes it easy to build reliable, scalable distributed applications with durable execution guarantees. It enables developers to write workflows as code with automatic retry, state persistence, and fault tolerance built in.

name: Prefect
description: Prefect is a modern data workflow orchestration platform that enables data engineers to build, schedule, and monitor reliable data pipelines in Python. It provides automatic retries, caching, and real-time observability for both simple scripts and complex multi-step data workflows.

name: Dagster
description: Dagster is an open-source data orchestration platform designed for developing and maintaining data assets with lineage, observability, and reliability. It treats data pipelines as software assets with declarative definitions, making data engineering workflows testable and maintainable.

name: Apache Airflow
description: Apache Airflow is the leading open-source workflow orchestration platform that enables data engineers to programmatically author, schedule, and monitor complex data pipelines using Python DAGs. It is widely deployed by data teams worldwide for orchestrating ETL processes, ML pipelines, and operational workflows.

name: Retool
description: Retool is an AI-powered platform for building internal business tools by connecting to databases, APIs, and services with a visual drag-and-drop interface. It enables developers to build custom admin panels, dashboards, and operational workflows without full custom development.

name: Appsmith
description: Appsmith is an open-source low-code platform for building custom internal tools, admin panels, and CRUD apps by connecting to any database or API. It provides a drag-and-drop builder with JavaScript customization, allowing teams to create production-grade internal applications rapidly.

name: Budibase
description: Budibase is an open-source low-code platform for building internal business tools, workflows, and CRUD apps with automation capabilities. It supports self-hosting, custom data sources, role-based access control, and built-in automation to rapidly build and deploy operational tools.

name: Tooljet
description: ToolJet is an open-source low-code platform for building internal business applications with a visual drag-and-drop builder that connects to databases, APIs, and cloud storage. It supports complex UI components, JavaScript customization, and workflow automation for building enterprise-grade internal tools.

name: Bubble
description: Bubble is a no-code application development platform that enables non-technical founders and teams to build web applications with complex logic, databases, and integrations without writing code. It powers thousands of startups and SaaS products with its visual programming environment.

name: Adalo
description: Adalo is a no-code platform for building native mobile and web applications with a drag-and-drop visual builder, integrated database, and app publishing capabilities. It enables non-developers to create and publish fully functional apps to the App Store and Google Play.

name: Glide
description: Glide is a no-code platform that turns spreadsheets and databases into beautiful mobile apps and internal tools without any coding. It connects directly to Google Sheets, Excel, Airtable, and other data sources to create custom data-driven applications instantly.

name: Softr
description: Softr is a no-code platform that builds web apps and client portals from Airtable or Google Sheets data, featuring beautiful pre-built templates for directories, portals, and marketplaces. It allows non-technical teams to quickly deploy member portals, internal tools, and web apps.

name: WeWeb
description: WeWeb is a no-code frontend builder for creating pixel-perfect web applications that connect to any backend, API, or database including Xano, Supabase, and Airtable. It enables designers and developers to build complex responsive web applications with advanced component libraries.

name: Xano
description: Xano is a no-code backend development platform that enables teams to build scalable APIs and database-driven backends without writing server-side code. It provides a visual function stack editor for creating complex business logic, authentication, and real-time capabilities.

name: Supabase
description: Supabase is an open-source Firebase alternative that provides a hosted PostgreSQL database, authentication, instant APIs, realtime subscriptions, and storage in a developer-friendly platform. It enables developers to build full-stack applications faster with less infrastructure management.

name: Firebase
description: Firebase is Google's backend-as-a-service platform providing real-time database, authentication, cloud functions, hosting, and analytics for web and mobile app development. It is widely used by developers and startups for building scalable applications with Google Cloud infrastructure.

name: Neon
description: Neon is a serverless PostgreSQL platform designed for modern development workflows, with instant branching, autoscaling, and scale-to-zero capabilities. It enables developers to create database branches for each feature or PR, making database development as easy as Git branching.

name: PlanetScale
description: PlanetScale is a serverless MySQL database platform built on Vitess, offering database branching, non-blocking schema changes, and horizontal sharding for scaling web applications. It is used by major companies for mission-critical database workloads requiring high availability and scale.

name: Upstash
description: Upstash is a serverless data platform offering Redis, Kafka, and vector database services with a pay-per-request pricing model designed for edge and serverless applications. It enables developers to add low-latency caching, queueing, and semantic search to applications without managing infrastructure.

name: Convex
description: Convex is a reactive backend-as-a-service platform that provides a real-time database, server functions, and automatic data sync for building collaborative and reactive web applications. Its TypeScript-native approach and built-in reactivity eliminate the need for manual state management.

name: Railway
description: Railway is a modern cloud deployment platform that makes it simple to provision infrastructure, develop locally, and deploy applications to the cloud with zero configuration. It supports automatic deployments from GitHub, managed databases, and straightforward environment management.

name: Render
description: Render is a unified cloud platform for hosting web apps, static sites, background workers, cron jobs, and managed databases with automatic deployments from Git. It is designed as a simple alternative to AWS and Heroku, with zero DevOps complexity.

name: Fly.io
description: Fly.io is an app deployment platform that runs full-stack applications and Docker containers at the edge, close to users worldwide, with automatic geographic distribution. It provides fast global deployments with persistent storage, private networking, and developer-friendly tooling.

name: Vercel
description: Vercel is the leading frontend deployment platform for Next.js and other modern web frameworks, providing instant global deployments, edge functions, and seamless Git integration. It is optimized for frontend performance with automatic CDN distribution, preview deployments, and serverless infrastructure.

name: Netlify
description: Netlify is a web deployment and development platform that provides continuous deployment from Git, serverless functions, edge functions, and form handling for modern web projects. It popularized the Jamstack architecture and provides a comprehensive developer experience for static and dynamic web apps.

name: Cloudflare Workers AI
description: Cloudflare Workers AI is an edge AI inference platform that runs AI models at Cloudflare's global network, enabling developers to run LLMs, image generation, and other AI tasks with ultra-low latency close to end users. It provides a serverless AI runtime integrated with Cloudflare's developer ecosystem.

name: Buffer
description: Buffer is an AI-powered social media management platform for scheduling posts, analyzing performance, and engaging with audiences across Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Pinterest. Its AI assistant helps create and repurpose content while providing analytics to optimize posting times.

name: Hootsuite
description: Hootsuite is a comprehensive AI-powered social media management platform that enables organizations to schedule content, monitor brand mentions, analyze performance, and manage multiple social profiles from a unified dashboard. Its OwlyWriter AI generates social captions and content ideas.

name: Sprout Social
description: Sprout Social is an AI-powered social media management platform providing scheduling, social listening, analytics, and customer care tools for brands and agencies. Its AI-driven features include sentiment analysis, predictive best send times, and content performance forecasting.

name: Later
description: Later is an AI-powered social media scheduling and analytics platform focused on visual content planning for Instagram, TikTok, and other social networks. Its visual content calendar, link-in-bio tools, and AI caption writer help creators and brands plan and publish engaging content.

name: Planoly
description: Planoly is an AI-powered visual social media planner and scheduler designed for Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, and other visual platforms. It provides a drag-and-drop grid planner, AI caption generation, and analytics tools for brands and creators focused on aesthetic content.

name: Socialbee
description: SocialBee is an AI-powered social media management tool with content categorization features that help businesses maintain a balanced social media posting strategy. Its AI content generation creates posts tailored to brand voice, while content categories ensure diverse, evergreen posting schedules.

name: Publer
description: Publer is an AI-powered social media scheduling and collaboration tool that supports Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Twitter, LinkedIn, Google Business, Pinterest, YouTube, and Telegram. Its AI Assist feature generates captions, hashtags, and content ideas directly within the scheduling workflow.

name: CoSchedule
description: CoSchedule is an AI-powered marketing calendar and social media scheduling platform that centralizes all marketing activities in a unified content calendar. Its AI Headline Studio analyzes and scores headline quality, while the marketing calendar integrates social, email, and content workflows.

name: Iconosquare
description: Iconosquare is an AI-powered social media analytics and scheduling platform focused on providing deep insights for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Twitter. It offers comprehensive reporting, competitive analysis, and content performance tracking for brands and agencies.

name: Brandwatch
description: Brandwatch is an AI-powered social intelligence platform that provides deep consumer insights through social listening, sentiment analysis, and trend detection across billions of online conversations. It helps brands understand audience sentiment, monitor brand health, and identify emerging trends.

name: Sprinklr
description: Sprinklr is an enterprise AI-powered unified customer experience management platform that combines social media marketing, customer service, and market research in one platform. Its AI processes billions of customer signals to deliver predictive insights and automated customer engagement at scale.

name: Agorapulse
description: Agorapulse is an AI-powered social media management platform with scheduling, inbox management, social listening, and reporting features for teams and agencies. Its shared social inbox centralizes all comments, messages, and mentions, enabling efficient team collaboration on customer responses.

name: Sendible
description: Sendible is an AI-powered social media management tool designed for agencies and teams, providing scheduling, brand monitoring, and detailed analytics across all major social platforms. Its Canva integration and content suggestion features streamline the social content creation workflow.

name: SocialPilot
description: SocialPilot is an AI-powered social media management tool for small businesses and agencies, offering scheduling, content curation, team collaboration, and analytics at an affordable price. Its AI assistant generates captions and content ideas while the bulk scheduling feature streamlines large-volume posting.

name: Loomly
description: Loomly is an AI-powered brand success platform that provides a content calendar, post optimization tips, post builder, and detailed analytics for social media teams. It offers automated post ideas based on trending topics and best practices, along with approval workflows for team collaboration.

name: Tailwind
description: Tailwind is an AI-powered social media scheduling and marketing tool specialized for Pinterest and Instagram, offering SmartSchedule for optimal posting times and Ghostwriter AI for caption creation. Its Create tool generates on-brand post designs automatically from brand assets.

name: Predis.ai
description: Predis.ai is an AI-powered social media content creation and scheduling platform that generates complete posts including text, images, and hashtags from a single keyword or topic input. It supports creation for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, and other platforms with brand-consistent styling.

name: Lately
description: Lately is an AI-powered social media content platform that uses neural networks trained on high-performing content to generate engaging social posts from long-form content like blogs, videos, and podcasts. It automatically repurposes existing content into dozens of social media-ready snippets.

name: Flick
description: Flick is an AI-powered social media marketing platform that specializes in hashtag research, AI content creation, and post scheduling for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and Facebook. Its AI Social Media Marketing Assistant generates content strategies, captions, and hashtag sets tailored to brand voice.

name: Ocoya
description: Ocoya is an AI-powered social media management platform that combines content creation, scheduling, and analytics with a built-in graphic design tool and AI copywriting. It enables teams to create on-brand social posts with AI-generated captions and visuals and schedule them across multiple platforms.

name: ContentStudio
description: ContentStudio is an AI-powered content marketing and social media management platform that combines content discovery, creation, scheduling, and analytics in one tool. Its AI composer generates social captions and blog posts, while content discovery surfaces trending topics relevant to any industry.

name: Missinglettr
description: Missinglettr is an AI-powered social media automation tool that automatically creates year-long social media campaigns from blog posts, extracting key quotes and images to generate a drip campaign of social content. It is particularly useful for bloggers and content marketers who want to maximize content reach.

name: Taplio
description: Taplio is an AI-powered LinkedIn growth tool that helps professionals create high-performing content, schedule posts, engage with their network, and track analytics on LinkedIn. Its AI generates posts based on high-performing content in any industry and provides a personal CRM for LinkedIn networking.

name: AuthoredUp
description: AuthoredUp is an AI-powered LinkedIn content creation and analytics tool that helps creators write better posts with formatting tools, post templates, and a content library. It provides detailed analytics on post performance, follower growth, and engagement metrics for LinkedIn creators.

name: Shield Analytics
description: Shield Analytics is a dedicated LinkedIn analytics platform that provides deep insights into content performance, audience engagement, and follower growth for LinkedIn creators and businesses. It tracks post metrics, identifies best-performing content patterns, and helps optimize LinkedIn content strategy.

name: Repurpose.io
description: Repurpose.io is an AI-powered content repurposing and distribution platform that automatically converts podcast episodes, YouTube videos, and blog posts into short-form content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook, and other social platforms. It streamlines the multi-platform content distribution workflow.

name: Canva Social
description: Canva Social is the social media scheduling and publishing feature within Canva that allows users to create, schedule, and publish social media posts across multiple platforms directly from the Canva design environment. It combines Canva's AI design tools with social media publishing in one workflow.

name: Pablo by Buffer
description: Pablo by Buffer is a free, simple online tool for creating social media images quickly with text overlays on photos from a curated library. It is designed for quick social media image creation without needing design skills, and integrates directly with Buffer for immediate scheduling.

name: Crello (VistaCreate)
description: VistaCreate (formerly Crello) is an AI-powered graphic design platform for creating animated and static social media content, presentations, and marketing materials using a large library of templates and assets. It provides a Canva-like experience with animation capabilities and brand kit management.

name: Stencil
description: Stencil is a fast, simple graphic design tool for creating social media graphics, blog images, and marketing visuals using thousands of templates and a large stock photo library. It is designed for marketers and bloggers who need to create professional-quality social images quickly without design expertise.

name: Zillow AI
description: Zillow uses AI and machine learning to power its Zestimate home valuation tool, providing automated property value estimates for over 100 million homes in the US. Its AI also powers personalized listing recommendations, natural language property search, and market trend analysis.

name: Redfin AI
description: Redfin uses AI to power property valuations, personalized home recommendations, and real-time market analytics for buyers and sellers. Its AI-driven search understands natural language queries and its Redfin Estimate provides automated home valuations updated daily based on the latest market data.

name: Compass AI
description: Compass is an AI-powered real estate technology platform that provides agents and buyers with market insights, pricing recommendations, and a suite of digital tools for the home buying and selling process. Its AI analyzes market conditions to recommend optimal listing prices and timing strategies.

name: Matterport
description: Matterport is the leading AI-powered platform for creating immersive 3D digital twins and virtual tours of physical spaces, widely used in real estate, construction, and hospitality. Its AI automatically generates floor plans, measurements, and property descriptions from 3D scans.

name: Rechat
description: Rechat is an AI-powered real estate CRM and marketing platform designed for real estate agents and brokerages, combining contact management, marketing automation, and transaction coordination. Its AI provides personalized follow-up recommendations and automates client communication workflows.

name: Follow Up Boss
description: Follow Up Boss is a real estate CRM that centralizes leads from all sources and automates follow-up with AI-driven workflows and texting to help agents convert more leads into clients. It integrates with 200+ real estate lead sources and provides team management features for brokerages.

name: kvCORE
description: kvCORE is an AI-powered real estate platform for agents, teams, and brokerages that combines a website, CRM, lead generation, and marketing automation in one system. Its AI behavioral engine automatically nurtures leads with intelligent follow-up based on prospect behavior and engagement signals.

name: Roof AI
description: Roof AI is an AI-powered chatbot and virtual assistant platform for real estate websites that automatically qualifies leads, schedules appointments, and engages with site visitors 24/7. It integrates with real estate CRMs to deliver qualified leads directly to agents with full conversation context.

name: Offrs
description: Offrs is a predictive analytics platform for real estate that uses AI to identify homeowners most likely to sell within the next 12 months in any given territory. It provides agents with exclusive seller leads and automated marketing tools to connect with potential sellers before they list.

name: Restb.ai
description: Restb.ai is an AI-powered computer vision platform for real estate that automatically analyzes property photos to detect features, condition, and room types, and generates listing descriptions. Its image recognition technology helps MLSs and real estate companies automate property data enrichment.

name: HouseCanary
description: HouseCanary is an AI-powered real estate analytics company that provides automated property valuations, market forecasting, and investment analytics for lenders, investors, and real estate professionals. Its AVM (Automated Valuation Model) covers over 100 million properties across the US.

name: Cotality
description: CoreLogic is a leading provider of AI-powered property data, analytics, and services for the real estate and mortgage industries. It offers property data for 99% of US parcels and provides AI-driven analytics for valuations, risk assessment, fraud detection, and market intelligence.

name: Reonomy
description: Reonomy is an AI-powered commercial real estate data and analytics platform that aggregates property, ownership, tenant, and debt data to help CRE professionals identify and analyze investment opportunities. Its AI unifies fragmented property records to provide comprehensive deal intelligence.

name: Skyline AI
description: Skyline AI is an AI-powered commercial real estate investment management platform that uses machine learning to analyze thousands of data points for multifamily property acquisitions and asset management. It provides institutional investors with AI-driven deal sourcing, underwriting, and portfolio optimization.

name: Ylopo
description: Ylopo is an AI-powered real estate digital marketing and lead generation platform that uses retargeting, dynamic home search ads, and AI lead nurturing to help agents and teams generate and convert leads. Its RAIYA AI follow-up assistant automatically texts and calls leads 24/7.

name: Lofty
description: Lofty is an AI-powered real estate platform combining a smart CRM, website, and lead generation tools designed for modern real estate agents and teams. Its AI assistant Lofty AI automatically engages and qualifies leads via SMS and email, while the smart CRM predicts which leads are most likely to convert.

name: Inside Real Estate
description: Inside Real Estate provides the kvCORE platform and related AI-powered solutions for agents, teams, and brokerages, focusing on intelligent lead management and marketing automation. Its AI behavioral system engages leads across multiple channels to maximize conversion rates.

name: Structurely
description: Structurely is an AI real estate assistant that conducts human-like SMS and email conversations with leads to qualify, nurture, and book appointments for real estate agents. Its AI, named Aisa Holmes, can handle complex multi-turn conversations and hand off qualified leads to agents at the right moment.

name: Nifty
description: AI-powered project management platform that combines roadmaps, tasks, docs, and chat in one workspace.

name: Wrike AI
description: Wrike is an AI-powered project management and work collaboration platform that provides real-time visibility, AI-generated project insights, and automation for complex team workflows. Its Work Intelligence AI features include risk prediction, smart task automation, and AI-powered project summaries.

name: Smartsheet AI
description: Smartsheet is an enterprise AI-powered work management platform that combines spreadsheet-like interfaces with project management, workflow automation, and reporting capabilities. Its AI features include formula generation, content creation, and automated data extraction from documents.

name: Zoho Projects AI
description: Zoho Projects is an AI-powered project management tool that combines task management, Gantt charts, time tracking, and collaboration features with Zia AI for intelligent insights and automation. It integrates deeply with the broader Zoho ecosystem for CRM, finance, and HR data.

name: Notion Calendar
description: Notion Calendar is an AI-powered calendar application by Notion that integrates deeply with Notion workspace data, allowing users to connect meetings with notes, docs, and projects. It offers smart scheduling, time blocking, and unified views of Google Calendar events alongside Notion databases.

name: Stormboard AI
description: Stormboard is an AI-powered collaborative digital workspace and whiteboard tool for brainstorming, planning, and organizing ideas in structured sticky-note-based formats. Its AI features generate structured reports, summaries, and action items directly from collaborative whiteboard sessions.

name: FigJam AI
description: FigJam is Figma's AI-powered collaborative online whiteboard designed for brainstorming, diagramming, and workshop facilitation. Its AI features include generating diagrams, summarizing sticky notes, creating flowcharts, and turning ideas into structured content for design and product teams.

name: Whimsical AI
description: Whimsical is an AI-powered visual workspace for creating flowcharts, wireframes, mind maps, and sticky note boards for product and design teams. Its AI can generate diagrams and flowcharts from text descriptions, accelerating the visual thinking and planning process.

name: Lucidchart AI
description: Lucidchart is an AI-powered diagramming and visual collaboration platform for creating flowcharts, org charts, network diagrams, and process maps. Its AI features include generating diagrams from natural language descriptions and auto-summarizing complex diagrams into plain language.

name: Draw.io
description: Draw.io (diagrams.net) is a free, open-source diagramming tool for creating flowcharts, network diagrams, UML, and other visual diagrams, with integrations for Google Drive, Confluence, Jira, and GitHub. It is widely used for technical documentation and collaborative diagram creation.

name: Excalidraw
description: Excalidraw is an open-source virtual whiteboard tool with a hand-drawn aesthetic for creating sketches, diagrams, and wireframes. Its collaborative features allow multiple users to draw simultaneously in real time, and its AI feature can generate diagrams from text descriptions.

name: Eraser.io
description: Eraser.io is an AI-powered technical diagramming tool designed for engineering and product teams, enabling creation of system architecture diagrams, sequence diagrams, and ERDs alongside markdown documentation. Its AI can generate diagrams from natural language descriptions and code.

name: AskYourPDF
description: AskYourPDF is an AI-powered tool that allows users to upload PDF documents and interact with them through natural language questions and answers. It uses RAG technology to extract and summarize relevant information from PDFs, making document research faster and more interactive.

name: DocuAsk
description: DocuAsk is an AI-powered document question-answering tool that enables users to upload documents and ask questions to extract information quickly. It supports multiple file formats and helps professionals find answers within complex documents without manual reading.

name: PDF.ai
description: PDF.ai is an AI-powered PDF interaction tool that allows users to chat with their PDF documents to extract information, get summaries, and ask specific questions. It supports large documents and multiple PDFs simultaneously, making it useful for research and professional document analysis.

name: Docalysis
description: Docalysis is an AI-powered document analysis tool that enables users to upload PDFs and other documents and ask questions to quickly extract key information and insights. It is designed for professionals who need to analyze large volumes of documents efficiently.

name: Sharly AI
description: Sharly AI is an AI document summarization and question-answering tool that helps professionals quickly extract insights from PDFs, reports, and documents. It supports uploading multiple documents and asking cross-document questions, making it useful for research and competitive analysis.

name: LightPDF AI
description: LightPDF is an AI-powered PDF solution that provides chat with PDF, document translation, OCR, editing, and conversion tools in a unified platform. Its AI assistant can answer questions about document content and summarize long documents across multiple languages.

name: Smallpdf AI
description: Smallpdf is an AI-powered online PDF toolset offering compression, conversion, editing, signing, and chat-with-PDF capabilities in a simple interface. Its AI PDF summarizer and chat feature allow users to quickly understand and interact with documents without reading them in full.

name: iLovePDF
description: iLovePDF is a comprehensive online PDF tool suite that provides over 20 tools for merging, splitting, compressing, converting, and editing PDF files, with AI-powered features for document summarization and organization. It is widely used by individuals and businesses for everyday PDF workflow tasks.

name: DocSend
description: DocSend is an AI-powered secure document sharing and analytics platform that provides real-time insights into how recipients engage with shared documents, including time spent per page and viewer identity. It is widely used by sales teams and startups to share pitch decks and proposals with tracking.

name: Pandoc
description: Pandoc is a free, open-source universal document converter that transforms documents between dozens of markup and word processing formats, including Markdown, HTML, LaTeX, Word, PDF, and many others. It is widely used by academics, technical writers, and developers for document conversion workflows.

name: Docusaurus
description: Docusaurus is an open-source documentation website builder by Meta that makes it easy to create, maintain, and publish documentation sites from Markdown files. It provides versioning, internationalization, search, and theming capabilities for technical product documentation.

name: GitBook
description: GitBook is an AI-powered documentation platform that enables teams to create, manage, and publish technical documentation with AI assistance for writing and search. Its AI-powered search understands natural language queries and its Git sync keeps docs in sync with code repositories.

name: ReadMe
description: ReadMe is an AI-powered API documentation platform that creates interactive, personalized developer documentation with real-time API explorer, usage metrics, and AI-assisted troubleshooting. Its Owlbot AI answers developer questions by searching documentation and helping debug API issues.

name: Swagger/OpenAPI
description: Swagger (now SmartBear) is the world's most widely used API documentation and design toolset, built around the OpenAPI specification standard. It provides tools for designing, building, documenting, and testing REST APIs with auto-generated interactive documentation.

name: Postman
description: Postman is the world's leading API platform for building, testing, documenting, and monitoring APIs, with AI-powered features for automated API testing and documentation generation. Its Postbot AI assistant helps write test scripts, suggests fixes for failing tests, and generates documentation.

name: Insomnia
description: Insomnia is an open-source API client for designing, debugging, and testing REST, GraphQL, and gRPC APIs with a clean collaborative interface. It provides environment management, request chaining, and automated testing capabilities for development teams.

name: RapidAPI
description: RapidAPI is the world's largest API marketplace where developers can discover, test, and connect to thousands of public and private APIs in one place. It provides a unified interface for API management, testing, and monetization for both API providers and consumers.

name: Hoppscotch
description: Hoppscotch is an open-source, lightweight API development tool for testing REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, and other API protocols directly in the browser or as a self-hosted app. It is a popular, fast alternative to Postman with a minimalist interface and real-time collaboration features.

name: Twilio
description: Twilio is a cloud communications platform providing AI-powered messaging, voice, email, and video APIs for building customer engagement applications. Its CustomerAI combines real-time customer data with generative AI to personalize interactions across SMS, WhatsApp, voice, and email channels.

name: SendGrid
description: SendGrid is a cloud-based email delivery platform by Twilio that provides transactional and marketing email APIs with high deliverability, analytics, and compliance tools. It is used by developers and marketers to send billions of emails reliably with advanced tracking and optimization features.

name: Mailgun
description: Mailgun is a developer-first email API platform that provides transactional email sending, email validation, and inbox placement tools for applications. It offers powerful email routing, parsing, and tracking capabilities for developers building email-driven applications.

name: Resend
description: Resend is a modern email API platform designed for developers that makes sending transactional emails simple, reliable, and with excellent deliverability. Built with React Email support, it provides a developer-friendly SDK, domain authentication, and email analytics.

name: Novu
description: Novu is an open-source notification infrastructure platform that provides a unified API for sending notifications across email, SMS, push, in-app, Slack, and other channels. It enables developers to manage notification workflows, user preferences, and delivery across all channels from a single integration.

name: OneSignal
description: OneSignal is a customer messaging and engagement platform that provides push notifications, in-app messages, SMS, and email with AI-powered personalization and delivery optimization. It is used by thousands of apps and websites to engage users with targeted, automated messaging.

name: Pusher
description: Pusher is a hosted API platform for building real-time features like live notifications, activity feeds, chat, and presence indicators into web and mobile applications. It provides Channels for pub/sub messaging and Beams for push notifications with a developer-friendly SDK.

name: Ably
description: Ably is a reliable real-time messaging and event streaming infrastructure platform for building mission-critical live features in applications. It provides guaranteed message delivery, ordering, and persistence with pub/sub, presence, and push notification capabilities at massive scale.

name: Agora
description: Agora is a real-time voice, video, and interactive live streaming API platform that powers in-app communication features for social, gaming, education, and enterprise applications. It provides low-latency, high-quality audio and video infrastructure with AI-powered features like noise suppression.

name: LiveKit
description: LiveKit is an open-source WebRTC infrastructure platform for building real-time audio, video, and data applications at scale, commonly used for building AI voice agents and multi-party video applications. It provides server-side media processing, AI agent integration, and scalable media routing.

name: Daily
description: Daily.co is a WebRTC video API platform that provides reliable, low-latency video and audio infrastructure for embedding calls into web and mobile applications. It offers a complete video SDK with screen sharing, recording, custom layouts, and prebuilt UI components.

name: Whereby
description: Whereby is a simple, browser-based video conferencing platform that requires no downloads or account creation for guests and provides persistent meeting rooms with custom URLs. It is popular for small teams, tutors, and customer-facing video meetings.

name: Zoom AI Companion
description: Zoom AI Companion is Zoom's built-in generative AI assistant that provides meeting summaries, action item extraction, in-meeting question answering, and chat composition across Zoom Meetings, Team Chat, and Phone. It is included at no additional cost for paid Zoom users.

name: Microsoft Teams AI
description: Microsoft Teams with Copilot AI provides enterprise collaboration with AI-powered meeting summaries, chat assistance, and intelligent search across the Microsoft 365 ecosystem. Teams AI includes Copilot for summarizing conversations, generating meeting notes, and automating tasks within chats.

name: Slack AI
description: Slack with Slack AI provides enterprise team messaging with AI-powered channel summaries, thread recaps, search answers, and workflow automation. Its AI features help teams catch up on missed conversations quickly and find information across the organization's Slack history.

name: Discord AI
description: Discord is a community and gaming communication platform that integrates AI features including Clyde AI for answering questions in servers, AutoMod AI for content moderation, and a rich ecosystem of AI bots. It hosts large developer and AI research communities with AI-powered moderation tools.

name: Gather
description: Gather is an AI-powered virtual office platform that recreates the spontaneous collaboration of in-person offices through a 2D spatial video chat environment. Teams can move around a virtual office floor plan and initiate video conversations by walking up to colleagues' avatars.

name: Tandem
description: Tandem is an AI-powered virtual office app that enables remote teams to see who's available and jump into conversations with one click, mimicking the spontaneous communication of co-located teams. It integrates with other tools and shows real-time status across the team's virtual office.

name: Around
description: Around is an AI-powered video call application designed for focused remote work, featuring automatic background blur, noise cancellation, and a compact floating video interface that stays out of the way during work. It is optimized for quick check-ins and collaborative work sessions for remote teams.

name: Tuple
description: Tuple is an AI-powered remote pair programming tool designed specifically for developers, providing ultra-low latency screen sharing, remote control, and high-quality audio optimized for coding sessions. It is built from the ground up for pair programming workflows with features like drawing on screen and multiple cursor support.

name: Remio
description: Remio is a local-first AI knowledge assistant that runs in the background and automatically captures your files, webpages, meetings, emails, and notes into a private personal knowledge base you can search and ask questions across.

name: Roblox GUI Maker
description: Roblox GUI Maker is an AI tool that turns a text prompt into Roblox-style interface mockups (shops, HUDs, inventory, popups, admin panels) with a structured component plan and named hierarchy you can rebuild in Roblox Studio.

name: Auferet
description: Auferet is an AI game master for solo text adventures and tabletop-style RPGs. It keeps a persistent memory of your story and lets you upload your own lore, so the world stays consistent across long sessions. Plays in the browser and on Android, with dedicated D&D 5e and Pathfinder 2e modes.

name: Recapo.ai
description: Recapo.ai is an AI video editing platform that turns long-form video into publish-ready short clips. It understands long footage to generate plot summaries and highlights, drafts scripts, adds synchronized subtitles and AI voiceover, and exports vertical clips for TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts. It offers dedicated modes for film and TV recaps, talking-head clips with speaker focus, and product promos that match A-roll with B-roll, plus batch generation and cloud rendering.

name: DaoXE
description: OpenAI-compatible, multi-protocol LLM gateway providing Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek and more through one base URL and API key. Supports Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses, and Anthropic Messages (Claude native).

name: Markstream
description: Open-source streaming Markdown renderer for AI chat interfaces. It renders incomplete token-by-token Markdown and ships packages for Vue, React, Svelte, Angular, and Vue 2, with Mermaid, KaTeX, Shiki, Monaco, and safe HTML support.

name: Better Agent
description: Local workspace for running parallel Claude, Codex, and Gemini coding-agent sessions in one place, with per-session provider and model choice, delegation and forking across providers, approvals, and restart recovery for sessions that outlive a closed tab.

name: FPVTune
description: FPVTune is an AI assistant for FPV drone pilots that uses a neural network to analyze Betaflight blackbox logs and suggest practical PID and filter tuning changes.

name: Image Describer
description: Image Describer is an AI tool that turns an uploaded image into text, generating descriptions, WCAG-oriented alt text, OCR extractions, image-to-prompt output, and social captions.

name: Blur Background
description: Blur Background is a photo tool from Vignra that blurs image backgrounds while keeping the subject sharp, running its free tier locally in the browser with an optional AI-assisted subject mask.

name: Video Upscaler
description: Video Upscaler is an online AI video enhancer that upscales low-resolution footage to HD or 4K, applying restoration, denoising, and sharpening through a credit-based workflow.

name: Answerdeck
description: Answerdeck is a compliance intelligence platform that drafts security questionnaire answers from a company's own documents, Slack, Jira, and past questionnaires, with every answer cited and reviewed by a person before it is sent.

name: BrikSync PropOS
description: BrikSync PropOS is a property operating system for landlords, property managers, and brokers, covering properties, units, leases, rent, maintenance, and commissions with role-based access.

name: Sharpniq
description: Sharpniq removes blur from photos in the browser, running the model on your own device so the image is never uploaded, with an optional paid mode that processes larger files on its servers.

name: CVExpert
description: CVExpert is a job-search workspace for candidates, tailoring a CV to a specific role, drafting application material, and tracking applications, with free CV checks that need no account.

name: Gemini 3
description: Gemini 3 is Google's flagship model, available in the Gemini app, across Google Workspace, and through the Vertex AI API. It reads text, images, audio, and video, and its long context window lets it work through very large inputs such as full codebases or hours of transcripts in one go. It is strong on multimodal tasks where the model has to reason across different formats at once, and Google's free tier makes it easy to try before committing to a paid plan.

name: Google Veo 3
description: Veo 3 is Google DeepMind's video generation model and the successor to Veo 2. It generates clips up to 4K in both landscape and portrait, and it produces sound along with the video instead of leaving you to add it later. It tends to lead on prompt adherence, which makes it a strong pick for narrative scenes and establishing shots where the output has to match a specific brief. It is available through Google Labs and the Vertex AI API for production use.

name: GPT Image 2
description: GPT Image 2 is OpenAI's image generation model, built into ChatGPT and available through the OpenAI API. It handles the things earlier generators struggled with: readable text inside images, precise edits to an existing picture, and prompts that describe several objects and their positions. In 2026 comparisons it scores at the top for realistic output and prompt accuracy, which is why a lot of teams reach for it as their default for product shots, marketing images, and quick mockups.

name: GPT-5
description: GPT-5 is OpenAI's flagship model and the engine behind the current version of ChatGPT. It handles text, images, audio, and code in one model, and it decides how much to think about a problem based on how hard the problem is, so simple questions come back quickly while harder ones get more reasoning. It is a common default for coding, long analysis, and agent workflows, and it is available in ChatGPT and through the OpenAI API that a large share of AI products are built on.

name: Nano Banana Pro
description: Nano Banana Pro is Google's image generation model, available through Gemini and the Google AI tooling. Its main selling points are speed and detail: it renders 4K images in under ten seconds and does well on photorealism and legible text, two areas that used to force a trade-off. It fits workflows where people iterate quickly on a lot of variations, such as social posts, ad creative, and thumbnail testing, and want each pass to come back fast enough to keep the momentum going.

name: Best of AI
description: Best of AI is a curated, open source directory of AI tools. Every listing is a Markdown file in a public GitHub repo — browse by category or profession, filter by price, search, or check the leaderboard for top-ranked picks. Free to browse; full index at /index.json.

name: AI for Developers
description: A Substack newsletter for developers who want to actually use AI in their work, with tutorials, tool picks, and hands-on examples.

name: Altern Newsletter
description: The Altern team's weekly pick of new AI tools, resources, and community finds.
